observations.finding: Scoped sockets can attach sandbox/app identity to a new Wayland connection. This can shrink custom attribution for launched or sandboxed clients, but the backend must still own trusted identity fallback when no scoped socket is present.
Foreign toplevel handles can carry enough lifecycle/listing signal to reduce custom surface discovery, subject to compositor support and metadata completeness.
No standard protocol in this probe provides synchronous per-surface input denial in the compositor input path.

Image copy capture can request capture of image sources including toplevels into client-provided buffers. This can move capture transport toward standard protocol support where the compositor exposes the required source objects.
No standard protocol in this probe provides authority for DE-controlled per-surface move/resize geometry.
